👍 THUMBS UP FOR MORE UPDATES! 👍
Clean up the slimes as fast as you can! They need your help!

🖥️ PC COMPATIBLE, 🎮 CONSOLE COMPATIBLE, 📱MOBILE COMPATIBLE

🧴 Squish gooey slimes and watch the mess disappear!
🐾 Recruit adorable Slime Pets to help you clean faster!
🧲 Use Magnet Powers to suck up cash from a distance!
💰 The bigger the mess, the bigger the payout!
✨ Upgrade your gear and become the ultimate Slime Squisher!

How fast can YOU clean up? 🧼🟢
